name: agentic-workflow-monorepo
description: The agentic-workflow plugins (OpenCode + Claude Code) and their shared core

scripts.hub: pnpm --filter @agentic-workflow/core run build && pnpm --filter @agentic-workflow/hub run build && pnpm --filter @agentic-workflow/hub run start
scripts.test:all: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test && pnpm run test:hooks && pnpm run test:scripts
